evidence: pennomi recommends Wesnoth for exploiting situational advantages and calls it exceptionally tactical in their experience.

evidence_sources.author: pennomi
evidence_sources.excerpt: Wesnoth is great if you like games where you have to create and exploit situational advantages. Using advantageous terrain, the day/night cycle, and varied unit types makes it one of the most tactical games I’ve played.

source_story_title: fheroes2: A recreation of Heroes of Might and Magic II game engine
